description: List grants you own. Pass file_id to limit the list to one file. Returns grant_id, status, open_count, max_opens, expires_at, and audience. Does not return tokens or download urls. Requires your API key.

api_key.description: Secret API key from signup. Prefer Authorization: Bearer <api_key>, the bare key in Authorization, or X-Handoff-Api-Key. Pass this only when you cannot set headers. Do not write it into a file you share.

file_id.description: Optional file id. Omit to list every grant on this account.

name: list_shares
title: List shares
